question: How long is the introductory period for new hires at Ridgeline Outfitters?
expected_answer: 90 days, with check-ins at 30, 60, and 90 days; it can be extended once by up to 30 days.
expected_passages: Every new employee serves a 90-day introductory period.

question: How many PTO days does a full-time Ridgeline employee get per year?
expected_answer: 10 days per year in the first three years, then 15 days per year after three years of service.
expected_passages: In the first three years of employment, full-time employees earn 10 days of PTO per year. After three years of service, they earn 15 days per year.

question: What does Ridgeline contribute to employees' 401(k) accounts?
expected_answer: It matches 50 percent of the first 6 percent of pay the employee contributes, vesting over three years.
expected_passages: Ridgeline matches 50 percent of the first 6 percent of pay that you contribute.

question: What happens if a Ridgeline employee skips shifts without calling in?
expected_answer: Missing two consecutive scheduled shifts without calling in is treated as a voluntary resignation.
expected_passages: Missing two consecutive scheduled shifts without calling in is treated as a voluntary resignation.

question: When does Ridgeline pay overtime?
expected_answer: At one and a half times the regular rate for hours over 40 in a Monday-to-Sunday workweek, approved in advance by a store manager.
expected_passages: Hourly employees are paid overtime at one and a half times their regular rate for all hours worked over 40 in a workweek.

question: How much of a discount do Ridgeline employees get on gear?
expected_answer: 25 percent on regular-priced merchandise and 10 percent on sale merchandise.
expected_passages: Employees receive a 25 percent discount on regular-priced merchandise and a 10 percent discount on sale merchandise.

question: How long is probation for new staff at Copper Kettle Bakery?
expected_answer: 60 days.
expected_passages: New staff serve a 60-day probationary period.

question: At Copper Kettle, after how many hours of work does a staff member get a meal break?
expected_answer: Staff who work more than 5 hours get an unpaid 30-minute meal break.
expected_passages: Staff who work more than 5 hours get an unpaid 30-minute meal break.

question: How is overtime calculated at the bakery?
expected_answer: Time and a half for hours over 8 in a workday or over 40 in a workweek, and double time for hours over 12 in a workday.
expected_passages: Hourly staff are paid one and a half times their regular rate for any hours over 8 in a single workday and for any hours over 40 in a workweek.

question: When does a Copper Kettle baker have to report a burn or cut?
expected_answer: Immediately, and before the end of the shift, to the shop lead.
expected_passages: Report every injury, including small burns and cuts, to the shop lead immediately and before the end of your shift.

question: What is Copper Kettle Bakery's 401(k) match?
expected_answer: 100 percent of the first 3 percent of pay, vesting immediately, after six months of employment.
expected_passages: The bakery matches 100 percent of the first 3 percent of pay that you contribute.

question: How many vacation days do full-time bakery staff earn, and can they carry them over?
expected_answer: 12 days per year. Unused vacation does not carry over, but up to 5 unused days can be cashed out each December.
expected_passages: Full-time staff earn 12 days of paid vacation per year, accrued each pay period.

question: What temperature should the walk-in cooler be kept at?
expected_answer: Between 35 and 38 degrees Fahrenheit, never below 33.
expected_passages: Set the controller to hold the cooler between 35 and 38 degrees Fahrenheit.

question: How often does the condenser coil need cleaning?
expected_answer: Once a month, and every two weeks in summer or when the unit is near a fryer or grill.
expected_passages: Clean the condenser coil once a month, and every two weeks in summer or when the unit sits near a fryer or grill.

question: Who is allowed to work on the cooler's refrigerant?
expected_answer: Only a technician holding EPA Section 608 certification.
expected_passages: Any work on the refrigerant circuit is done only by a technician holding EPA Section 608 certification.

question: How do I check whether the cooler door gasket is sealing?
expected_answer: Close the door on a dollar bill at several points; if it slides out easily, the gasket needs replacing.
expected_passages: Close the door on a dollar bill at several points around the frame; if the bill slides out easily, the gasket is not sealing and must be replaced.

question: How much notice is needed to stop the linen agreement from renewing?
expected_answer: Written notice at least 60 days before the end of the current term.
expected_passages: the Agreement renews automatically for successive 12-month terms unless either party gives written notice of non-renewal at least 60 days before the end of the current term.

question: What is the late charge on overdue linen invoices?
expected_answer: 1.5 percent per month on balances more than 30 days past due.
expected_passages: Unpaid balances more than 30 days past due accrue a late charge of 1.5 percent per month.

question: How much can Bayside Linen raise its prices each year?
expected_answer: No more than 5 percent, once per year on the anniversary of the first delivery, with 30 days' written notice.
expected_passages: Supplier may increase rates once per year, on the anniversary of the first delivery, by no more than 5 percent.

question: What happens if Bayside Linen keeps missing deliveries?
expected_answer: If it misses two scheduled deliveries in any 90-day period, the customer may terminate without penalty.
expected_passages: If Supplier misses two scheduled deliveries in any 90-day period, Customer may terminate this Agreement without penalty by written notice.

question: How much tuition assistance does Ridgeline Outfitters offer?
expected_answer: The documents do not cover this; the assistant should say so.
